luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0025.value: Voice Recognition System standard (BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant per BMW US press release)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0025.notes: KBB spec table lists 'Voice Recognition System' as Standard on 530i. The 2023 US press release mentions voice commands to the BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant. No source states an LLM-based assistant for the US G60.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0028.value: Phone-as-key not stated; 'Proximity Sensing Keyless Entry' listed as standard
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0028.notes: Difference to DE: keyless proximity entry is standard on the US 530i but only in Travel Paket 7LK in Germany. BMW Digital Key / Digital Key Plus (UWB) not mentioned in any fetched US source.
